patch_description: Return to the SLSQP constrained-optimization architecture (which reached 0.98), but restructure it: (1) a two-stage pipeline — stage 1 runs a cheap repulsion pre-optimizer to spread points apart and normalize diameter, stage 2 polishes with SLSQP maximizing dmin subject to dmax<=1; (2) diverse structured seeds (icosahedron+2 poles, Fibonacci sphere variants, random-on-sphere) instead of only random starts; (3) vectorized pair-distance computations and best-of-restarts selection on the true dmin/dmax ratio. The repulsion stage gives SLSQP a well-conditioned starting point so each restart converges reliably, improving score per unit time versus pure SLSQP from random starts.
